answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The grove of work and the saffron of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a fable to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
